reviews.comment: Honestly a pretty easy course. Two exams total completely open note and not a lot of homework. Mainly group projects, readings before each class but not necessary to do well on exams. Her lectures can be a bit hard to comprehend but as long as you do the "Friday Reflections" then you're fine.

I took Rowe for SOCI319 (Sociology of Sport) to satisfy a core curriculum requirement. She is certainly passionate about the topic, but I felt that she didn't do the best job of presenting balanced/alternative perspectives on things (maybe I'm just sensitive to that because I disagreed with a lot of her opinions). She is a fair grader, though.
